content.hebrew: אֲ֒דוֹן נוֹרָא : אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא : אֱלוֹהַּ חַי : וְאֵל קַנָּא :
content.transliteration: Adon nora : asher niḳra : elowah ḥai : ve’el ḳanna :
content.english: O awesome master, you who are called Living God and Zealous God,

content.hebrew: חֲמֹל נִפְקָד : אֲשֶׁר נֶעְקָד : לְפָנֶיךָ : בְּיוֹם דִּינָא :
content.transliteration: Ḥamol nifḳad : asher ne‘ḳad : lefanecha : beyom dina :
content.english: Have compassion for [the Jewish people], who are being accounted, who are gathered in front of you on this day of judgment.

content.hebrew: רְצֵה שִׂיחָם : וּמַר רוּחָם : וְהַדְרִיכָם : אֱלֵי אָמְנָה :
content.transliteration: Retsē siḥam : umar ruḥam : vehadricham : elē omna :
content.english: Accept their words, and their bitter spirit; guide them to faith,

content.hebrew: הֱיוֹת נֶאְסָר : וְגַם נִמְסָר : עֲוֹן חֻבָּם : לְךָ אֵל נָא :
content.transliteration: Heyot ne’sar : veḡam nimsar : ‘avon ḥubbam : lecha el na :
content.english: So that their hidden iniquities will be bound up and handed over to you, O God, please.

content.hebrew: בְּיוֹם כִּפּוּר : לְהַפִּיל פּוּר : אֱלֵי נֶפֶַשׁ : אֲשֶׁר נַעְנָה :
content.transliteration: Beyom kippur : lehappil pur : elē nefesh : asher na‘na :
content.english: On Yom Kippur, cast a lot for the people afflicting their souls,

content.hebrew: לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה :
content.transliteration: Lechapper ‘al benē yisra’el mikkol ḥattotam aḥat bash-shana.
content.english: To atone for the Israelites from all their sins, once each year.

content.hebrew: לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה :
content.transliteration: Lechapper ‘al benē yisra’el mikkol ḥattotam aḥat bash-shana.
content.english: To atone for the Israelites from all their sins, once each year.

content.hebrew: לְ֒ךָ חִזְקִי : מְנַת חֶלְקִי : וּמִבְטָחִי : לְנַהְלֵנוּ :
content.transliteration: Lecha ḥizḳi : menat ḥelḳi : umivtaḥi : lenahleni :
content.english: To you, my stronghold, my lot, my portion, I put my trust to guide us,

content.hebrew: נְחֵנוּ נָא : אֱלֵי גַנָּה : בְּעֵת חַיִּים : וְתִרְצֵנוּ :
content.transliteration: Neḥenu na : elē ḡanna : be‘et ḥayyim : vetirtseni :
content.english: Lead us to Paradise, while we live, and accept us,

content.hebrew: וּבוֹ נֹאכַל : וְגַם נוּכַל : בְּעֵת בּוֹא יוֹם : תְּדִינֵנוּ :
content.transliteration: Uvo nochal : veḡam nuchal : be‘et bo yom : tedineni :
content.english: There we shall eat [our reward], and we shall be successful at the time when you judge us,

content.hebrew: וְנִשְׁתַּעְשָׁע : וְנִוָּשַׁע : דְּמוּת יִפְעַת : אֱלֹהֵינוּ :
content.transliteration: Venishta‘sha‘ : venivvasha‘ : demut yif‘at : elohenu :
content.english: And we shall enjoy, and be rescued, [surrounded by] the beautiful image of our God,

content.hebrew: בְּעֹז חֶבְיוֹן : אֱלֵי עֶלְיוֹן : מְקוֹם כִּסֵּא : וְהַמְּעֹנָה :
content.transliteration: Be‘oz ḥevyon : elē ‘elyon : meḳom kissē : vehamme‘ona :
content.english: In the concealed stronghold, on high, the place of the [divine] throne and dwelling.

content.hebrew: לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה :
content.transliteration: Lechapper ‘al benē yisra’el mikkol ḥattotam aḥat bash-shana.
content.english: To atone for the Israelites from all their sins, once each year.

content.hebrew: יְ֒סוֹד הַכֹּל : וְכֹל יָכֹל : רְאֵה הֶמְיַת : אֱמוּנֶיךָ :
content.transliteration: Yesod hakkol : vechol yachol : re’ē hemyat : emunecha :
content.english: O foundation of all, you who are is omnipotent, see the throngs of your faithful,

content.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בֹּכִים : אֲבָל חוֹכִים : תְּשׁוּעָה מִ־ : לְּפָנֶיךָ :
content.transliteration: Asher bochim : aval ḥochim : teshu‘a mi- : lefanech :
content.english: Who are crying, but hoping to be rescued by you.

content.hebrew: טְהָר לִבָּם : אֲשֶׁר שׁוּבָם : הֲשִׁיבֵם אֶל : מְעוֹנֶךָ :
content.transliteration: Tehor libbam : asher shuvam : hashivem el : me‘onecha :
content.english: Their hearts are pure and repenting. Bring them back to your dwelling place!

content.hebrew: וְתָדִיחַ : וְתַדִּיחַ : עֲוֹן אַשְׁמַת : הֲמוֹנֶיךָ :
content.transliteration: Vetadiyaḥ : vetaddiyaḥ : ‘avon ashmat : hamonecha :
content.english: Clean and cast away the iniquities, the crimes, of your masses.

content.hebrew: זְכוֹר גִּזְעָם : וְחוֹן זַרְעָם : וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ : בְּמִשְׁכָּנָהּ :
content.transliteration: Zechor giz‘am : veḥon zar‘am : vehannefesh : bemishkanah :
content.english: Remember their ancestors, and be kind to their children, and to the soul inside its dwelling.

content.hebrew: לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה :
content.transliteration: Lechapper ‘al benē yisra’el mikkol ḥattotam aḥat bash-shana.
content.english: To atone for the Israelites from all their sins, once each year.

content.hebrew: הֲ֒לֹא תֶחְזֶה : וְעַל מַה זֶּה : עֲוֹנֵינוּ : מְאֹד גָּבְרוּ :
content.transliteration: Halo teḥzē : ve‘al ma ze : ‘avonenu : me’od gaveru :
content.english: Don’t you see why it is that our sins are so many?
content.comments: The Hebrew in this stanza is very difficult, and the translation is tentative. The gist seems to be: the reason that we sin is that we are created from a number of different components, physical and spiritual, and the various components struggle with each other to gain supremacy. When our physical components overpower our spiritual ones, we sin.

content.hebrew: הֱיוֹת מִשְׁכָּן : אֲשֶׁר שָׁכַן : יְקַר אֶדֶר : מְאֹד קָשְׁרוּ :
content.transliteration: Heyot mishkan : asher shachan : yeḳar eder : me’od ḳasheru :
content.english: They conspire greatly [to sink the human being, which is] to be a dwelling place where the glory resides,

content.hebrew: יְסוֹדוֹתָיו : וְאֶבְיוֹתָיו : אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּ־ : אֲמָר נוֹצְרוּ :
content.transliteration: Yesodotav : ve’evyotav : asher bamma- : amar notseru :
content.english: Its foundations and structures, which were created by [divine] utterance,

content.hebrew: בְּדַם טִפָּה : וְעִם אַשְׁפָּה : בְּמֵי נִדָּה : וְנִקְשָׁרוּ :
content.transliteration: Bedam tippa : ve‘am ashpa : bemē nidda : veniḳsharu :
content.english: Are the drop of blood, and together with the quiver, bound up in menstrual water,

content.hebrew: וְזֶה יִזְעַף : וְזֶה יִיעָף : וְזֶה יִגְבַּר : אֱלֵי פִנָּה :
content.transliteration: Vezē yiz‘af : vezē yi‘af : vezē yiḡbar : elē finna :
content.english: One element rages, and one is fainting, while another overpowers, all the way to the corner.

content.hebrew: לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה :
content.transliteration: Lechapper ‘al benē yisra’el mikkol ḥattotam aḥat bash-shana.
content.english: To atone for the Israelites from all their sins, once each year.

content.hebrew: וְ֒יָהּ אָיוֹם : זְכוֹר הַיּוֹם : אֲשֶׁר בַּטִּיט : פְּקַדְתָּנִי :
content.transliteration: Veyah ayom : zechor hayyom : asher battit : peḳadtani :
content.english: Awesome God, remember, today, that you have destined me to physicality,

content.hebrew: נְתַתָּנִי : קְשַׁרְתָּנִי : בְּתוֹךְ כֶּלֶא : אֲסַרְתָּנִי :
content.transliteration: Netattani : ḳeshartani : betoch kelē : asartani :
content.english: You have placed me and bound me inside a prison, tied me up.

content.hebrew: זְדוֹן יִצְרִי : מְחֵה יוֹצְרִי : כְּמַעְלִי אַל : תְּדִינֵנִי :
content.transliteration: Zedon yitsri : meḥē yotseri : kema‘li al : tedineni :
content.english: Wipe out the wickedness of my inclination, O my creator! Do not judge me in accordance with my trespass.

content.hebrew: מְחֵה רִשְׁעִי : וְכַס פִּשְׁעִי : בְּיוֹם דִּין אַל : תְּבִיאֵנִי :
content.transliteration: Meḥē rish‘i : vechas pish‘i : beyom din al : tevi’eni :
content.english: Wipe out my evil deeds, and cover my crimes; on the day of judgment, do not bring me to judgment!

content.hebrew: זְכוֹר חֶשְׁקִי : וְתֵן חֶלְקִי : אֱלֵי שִׁבְעָה : וְלִשְׁמוֹנָה :
content.transliteration: Zechor ḥeshki : veten ḥelḳi : elē shiv‘a : velishmona :
content.english: Remember my yearning, and give me my portion among the seven and the eight righteous leaders.
content.comments: See Micah 5:4: We shall set up with [the Messiah] seven shepherds and eight princes of men.

content.hebrew: לְכַפֵּר עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתָם אַחַת בַּשָּׁנָה :
content.transliteration: Lechapper ‘al benē yisra’el mikkol ḥattotam aḥat bash-shana.
content.english: To atone for the Israelites from all their sins, once each year.
